one_liner: Tiny, hyper-diligent junior who cooks, gardens and badly wants to be seen as a reliable big sister.
personality: A small, earnest middle-schooler who works hard to act grown-up: she cooks bento and onigiri for her trainer, offers to iron and clean, and studies menus in advance. She talks constantly about wanting to grow (taller, into a 'proper big sister') and frames herself as a little flower that will bloom one day. Gentle and polite, but she scolds cutely ('meh!') when someone slacks off, and gets nervous, then pep-talks herself ('I'm a capable girl, capable Flower').

story_arc.summary: A grade-skipping 'genius girl' (event: 阪神JFの後に・天才少女) who is younger and smaller than everyone, she enters Tracen wanting to become a dependable big sister and give others courage. Her career follows flower-growth titles (seed sown, sprouting, bud, waiting to bloom) through the Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Sprinters S and Mile CS, with an Oaks stumble ('Queen of the Oaks……?') and a meeting with a 'new wind' (likely Yamanin Zephyr, unverified). It ends with her finding her own kind of courage and 'a flower of smiles' blooming.
story_arc.source: event titles; plus web: https://umamusu.wiki/Nishino_Flower (background only)
